title: 油价与宽松政策托底，AI高预期和融资风险分化；中国船舶、非凡领越待开盘验证 + 美股盘前：油价升至六周高位压制指数，SNOW与CIEN获强正反馈；AVGO、NTAP、HPE遭高预期惩罚
summary: 美伊冲突令Brent收涨1%，美股三大ETF收高但博通强劲业绩后的盘后报价仍偏弱；国内适度宽松政策与浙江创新券提供托底，中国船舶逾10亿美元订单、非凡领越加仓李宁形成公司级催化。AKShare实时证据失败，A/H广度与领涨结论不作推断。 道指、标普500和纳指100期指约+0.08%、-0.02%和-0.17%，10年期美债约4.776%，Brent约97.29美元。SNOW与CIEN财报后约涨24.29%和3%；AVGO、NTAP、HPE虽有强数字却下跌，只作风险观察。今晚关注ZS、IOT、DOCU、PATH与AMBA。

关键词云图

霍尔木兹风险适度宽松AI高预期造船订单创新券增持李宁复牌清盘液冷验真航空维修汇率稳定
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
美伊再次大规模交火，Brent收于95.63美元
美军打击伊朗南部沿岸，伊朗随后攻击美国在地区内的基地；Reuters称这是7月以来最大规模交火。Brent结算涨1.00%至95.63美元，WTI涨0.90%至91.01美元。事实支持A/H油气与油服相对强势，但特朗普称行动不会持续太久，油价冲高回落风险同样高。
政策
央行重申适度宽松，不以人民币贬值获取贸易优势
潘功胜在G20会议表示，央行将继续实施好适度宽松货币政策，并明确中国无意通过汇率贬值获取贸易竞争优势。对A/H的直接含义是流动性预期偏支持、人民币竞争性贬值尾部风险下降；银行、地产和成长估值能否受益仍须由利率与开盘成交验证。
政策
浙江科技与财政部门推出统一创新券支持体系
浙江省科技厅、财政厅发布意见，创新券通过全省统一系统免费向企业和创业者发放，可用于技术开发、研发设计、检验检测、知识产权等服务。政策利好本地中小科技服务需求，但尚无总额度与公司订单，不能直接外推为上市公司利润增量。
科技
博通AI半导体收入增221%，强业绩仍未换来盘后上涨
Broadcom披露Q3收入296亿美元、同比+86%，非GAAP EPS 3.32美元，AI半导体收入167亿美元、同比+221%；Q4收入指引约348亿美元。Futu 09:08 CST盘后买卖报价364.02—364.25美元，较367.24美元现金收盘中点约-0.85%，说明高预期仍压制估值；中芯国际、寒武纪及光通信链需等待本地量价确认。
产业
亚洲最大宽体机维修机库在上海投入运营
新华社称，中国东航的上海机库9月2日投入运营，可同时容纳9架宽体机和2架窄体机开展整机维修。事实增加航空维修基础设施能力；对中国东航及航空装备链是长期能力建设，短线仍受油价、利用率和维修订单兑现约束。
产业
液冷概念升温，但多家公司披露收入贡献仍很低
新朋股份称液冷机柜已形成样品订单并批量交付；康盛股份上半年液冷收入369.69万元且总体亏损，捷荣技术称AI液冷相关收入不超过上半年营收1%。事实支持产业渗透趋势，却不支持泛化追涨；优先验证订单、毛利和收入占比。
公告
中国船舶子公司签下逾10亿美元汽车运输船合同
中国船舶（600150）披露，控股子公司广船国际联合中船贸易签订10艘8,200车LNG双燃料汽车运输船合同，总金额逾10亿美元。订单量化且属于主营业务，利好造船景气与排产能见度；风险是长交付周期、钢价、汇率及利润确认节奏。
公告
非凡领越外部融资2.282亿港元继续增持李宁
非凡领越（00933）在市场购入1,725.35万股李宁（02331），约占李宁已发行股份0.67%，对价约2.28207亿港元并以外部融资结算；持股由约16.91%升至约17.58%。交易强化股权绑定，但新增杠杆及两只股票的同向波动是主要风险。
公告
洪桥集团9,180万美元收购安排临时下调控制权
洪桥集团（08137）9,180万美元收购Bona Global 73%股权的对价不变，但因泰国监管同意要求，交割后将暂时回转24%股权、使持股降至49%，获批后再恢复73%。资源资产逻辑仍在，监管、控制权与交割路径的不确定性上升。
公告
KNT终止配售并于09:00复牌，取消即时摊薄但风险高
KNT Holdings（01025）终止9月1日签订的配售协议，没有发行配售股份、没有收到所得款，港交所确认9月3日09:00复牌。取消即时摊薄是事实，但撤回原因涉及市场反馈，复牌跳空与流动性风险高，只作事件观察。
风险
三巽集团遭清盘呈请，股份继续停牌
三巽集团（06611）披露，8月25日被提出清盘呈请，聆讯定于11月5日；公告提示股份转让及中央结算交收可能受影响，且股份继续停牌。公司称目前未对经营及财务产生重大影响，但法律与结算尾部风险明确，不作多头推荐。

美股夜盘行情总结

指数
夜盘代理微涨，但道指ETF价差偏宽
Futu 09:08 CST盘后买卖中点相对现金收盘：QQQ约+0.04%、SPY约+0.02%、DIA约+0.15%；DIA买卖价530.79—532.00美元，价差明显偏宽。它们是盘后指示报价，不是指数期货或最后成交，方向只可视为偏平。
对照
行业榜与概念榜均未完成全分页，两个分组各输出0行
Moomoo行业目标5页/145项，Sparks概念目标5页/105项；真实浏览器翻页和加载更多均持续受频控，首屏只作发现。因此无法完成Top5/Bottom5代表股盘后确认、背离或潜在反转判断，不用首屏样本冒充全榜。
映射
博通高增长与负盘后反馈并存，A/H AI链只做条件式映射
博通AI半导体收入167亿美元、同比+221%，但盘后买卖中点较收盘约-0.85%；DELL盘后中点约-1.29%。若中芯国际、寒武纪、工业富联与光模块链守住前收、强于科创50/创业板并放量，才构成独立强势；否则按高预期压制处理。

盘前结论

事实：美股ETF收高、油价续涨，央行重申适度宽松；中国船舶和非凡领越披露量化事件。博通高增长后盘后指示仍约-0.85%，AI高预期约束延续。

判断：基准情景偏向油气、造船和强公告个股，科技只做相对强弱交易。任何方向都须以守住前收、强于基准和成交扩张三项共同确认。

不确定性：AKShare 08:53全源失败，不能给出A/H广度或领涨判断；Moomoo双榜也未完成全分页。

重点个股推荐

中国船舶
600150
重大订单

推荐理由：10艘8,200车LNG双燃料汽车运输船合同逾10亿美元，主营订单与造船景气一致。

触发因素：守住前收并在首小时放量强于上证指数和船舶板块；高开过大则等待回踩。

风险点：长交付周期、钢价和汇率波动、利润确认滞后。

中国海洋石油
00883 / 600938
油价映射

推荐理由：Brent/WTI收涨1.00%/0.90%，美伊冲突继续提供供给风险溢价。

触发因素：原油不回吐涨幅，两地上市股票分别强于恒指/沪指且成交扩张。

风险点：地缘快速降级、油价冲高回落、政策干预。

美的集团
000333 / 00300
回购支撑

推荐理由：累计回购9,979.8万股、占总股本1.31%，支付约80.2亿元，资本行动规模明确。

触发因素：A股守住回购区间下沿并强于家电板块；H股同步不出现明显折价扩大。

风险点：回购已部分计价、消费需求与原材料成本波动。

非凡领越
00933
增持李宁

推荐理由：2.28207亿港元增持使李宁持股升至约17.58%，事件量化且跨两只港股。

触发因素：开盘守住前收，成交放大且李宁（02331）同步强于恒生消费指数。

风险点：外部融资增加杠杆、持仓集中与同向波动。

KNT Holdings
01025
仅观察

推荐理由：终止配售取消即时摊薄并于09:00复牌，但撤回源于初步市场反馈。

触发因素：仅在形成连续成交、价差收窄并重新站稳前收后评估。

风险点：复牌跳空、极端波动、流动性与后续融资需求。

板块轮动看板

相对强势油气、油服与造船；地缘溢价和重大订单共同支撑。
政策催化创新服务、研发检测和知识产权服务；等待地方额度与订单。
条件式科技半导体、AI服务器、光通信与液冷；高预期下只认本地量价。
风险区高油耗航空、外部融资增持、复牌与清盘事件。

逻辑链条

美伊交火 → Brent/WTI上涨 → 油气现金流预期改善，但航空成本上升。
央行适度宽松 + 汇率稳定表态 → 流动性与风险偏好获得缓冲 → 仍需成交确认。
博通AI收入+221%但盘后偏弱 → 高预期压制 → A/H AI链不因业绩标题直接追涨。
逾10亿美元造船订单与2.28207亿港元增持 → 个股事件强于泛主题 → 优先观察相对强度。

风险雷达

地缘双向跳变

进一步交火会推升油价；快速降级则会打掉能源风险溢价。

AI高预期

博通强劲数字后盘后报价仍偏弱，标题利好不等于正价格反馈。

港股个股尾部风险

KNT复牌、三巽清盘呈请、洪桥控制权安排均可能造成异常波动。

A/H实时证据缺口

AKShare全源失败；不发布虚构的指数、广度、领涨与代表股数据。

排行覆盖缺口

Moomoo行业和Sparks概念全分页均失败，面板各保留0行。

数据来源与时间点

来源与时间：人民银行/G20公开报道、浙江省科技厅与财政厅、新华社、中国船舶与深交所公司公告、港交所披露易、Broadcom IR、Reuters、AP、证券时报、Futu OpenD与Moomoo。港股账本覆盖2026-09-02至09-03共199条公告，34条必审、5条纳入、0条待决，`--validate`通过；至少一条纳入事件不属于恒生科技。AKShare云端快照07:29早于目标窗口，08:53本地回退因上游SSL/断连返回status=error、analysisReady=false，A股与港股marketPhase均为previous_close_baseline，故不输出当天实时广度、领涨或代表股。Moomoo行业5页/145项与Sparks概念5页/105项均未完成全分页，两个面板各0行。Futu盘后指示报价抓取于2026-09-03 09:08 CST，不等同于期货或最后成交；页面更新于2026-09-03 09:12 CST。

Keyword Cloud

Hormuz riskAccommodative policyAI expectationsShip ordersInnovation vouchersLi Ning stakeResumption riskCooling realityAircraft MROFX stability
PositiveNegativeNeutralw1-w5 denotes heat/importance, not percentage moves.
Major News Summary
Global
US-Iran fire intensifies as Brent settles at $95.63
US forces struck Iran's southern coast and Iran attacked US bases across the region; Reuters called it the largest exchange since July. Brent settled +1.00% at $95.63 and WTI +0.90% at $91.01. This supports relative A/H oil and services strength, but Trump's comment that the campaign would not last long also raises reversal risk.
Policy
PBOC reiterates an accommodative stance and rejects competitive depreciation
At the G20 meeting, Pan Gongsheng said the PBOC would continue an appropriately accommodative policy and that China had no intention of using RMB depreciation for trade advantage. Liquidity expectations are supportive and the competitive-devaluation tail risk is lower, but rates and opening volume must validate any benefit to banks, property or growth.
Policy
Zhejiang launches a unified innovation-voucher support system
The provincial science and finance departments will issue free electronic vouchers through one system for technology development, R&D design, testing, IP and related services. The policy supports local small-technology service demand, but no aggregate budget or company orders were disclosed, so listed-company profit cannot be inferred.
Technology
Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue rises 221%, yet strong results fail to lift after-hours quotes
Broadcom reported Q3 revenue of $29.6 billion, +86%, non-GAAP EPS of $3.32 and AI semiconductor revenue of $16.7 billion, +221%; Q4 revenue guidance is about $34.8 billion. Futu's 09:08 CST after-hours bid/ask was $364.02-$364.25, with the midpoint about -0.85% versus the $367.24 cash close. High expectations still constrain valuation; SMIC, Cambricon and optical names need local price-volume confirmation.
Industry
Asia's largest wide-body aircraft maintenance hangar opens in Shanghai
Xinhua said China Eastern's Shanghai hangar opened on September 2 and can service nine wide-body and two narrow-body aircraft simultaneously. It expands maintenance infrastructure and is a long-term capability gain for China Eastern and aerospace suppliers, but oil, utilization and order conversion constrain the near-term read-through.
Industry
Liquid-cooling interest rises, but several companies disclose very small revenue contributions
XinPeng said liquid-cooling cabinets had sample orders and batch deliveries; Kangsheng disclosed RMB3.6969 million of first-half liquid-cooling revenue and an overall loss, while Jierong said AI liquid-cooling revenue was no more than 1% of first-half sales. The trend is real, but broad chasing is not; verify orders, margins and revenue mix.
Filing
CSSC unit signs vehicle-carrier contracts worth more than $1 billion
China CSSC Holdings (600150) said Guangzhou Shipyard International and CSTC signed contracts for ten 8,200-car LNG dual-fuel vehicle carriers worth more than $1 billion. The quantified core-business order supports shipbuilding visibility; risks are long delivery cycles, steel, FX and profit-recognition timing.
Filing
Viva Goods uses HK$228.207 million of external financing to buy more Li Ning shares
Viva Goods (00933) acquired 17.2535 million Li Ning (02331) shares, about 0.67% of issued shares, for about HK$228.207 million using external financing; its stake rose from about 16.91% to about 17.58%. The transaction tightens alignment but adds leverage and correlated price risk.
Filing
Honbridge's US$91.8 million acquisition temporarily reduces control
The US$91.8 million consideration for Honbridge's (08137) acquisition of 73% of Bona Global is unchanged, but a Thai regulatory-consent condition requires 24% to be transferred back temporarily, reducing the stake to 49% until approval restores 73%. The resource-asset thesis remains, while regulatory, control and completion uncertainty rises.
Filing
KNT cancels a placing and resumes at 09:00, removing immediate dilution but retaining high risk
KNT Holdings (01025) terminated the September 1 placing; no placing shares were issued and no proceeds received, while HKEX confirmed a 09:00 September 3 resumption. Immediate dilution is removed, but the cancellation followed market feedback and reopening-gap/liquidity risks are high. This is event-watch only.
Risk
Sanxun Group faces a winding-up petition and remains suspended
Sanxun Group (06611) disclosed an August 25 winding-up petition with a November 5 hearing; the filing warns that share transfers and CCASS settlement may be affected, and trading remains suspended. The company says operations and finances are not currently materially affected, but legal and settlement tail risks are explicit. It is not a bullish setup.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Indexes
Overnight proxies edge up, but DIA's spread is wide
At 09:08 CST, Futu after-hours bid/ask midpoints versus cash closes were about +0.04% for QQQ, +0.02% for SPY and +0.15% for DIA; DIA's $530.79-$532.00 spread was visibly wide. These are indicative after-hours quotes, not index futures or last trades, so the signal is only flat-to-firm.
Comparison
Neither industry nor concept ranking completed full pagination; both groups publish zero rows
The targets were five pages/145 Moomoo industries and five pages/105 Sparks concepts. Real-browser pagination and load-more attempts remained rate-limited, and first pages were discovery-only. Complete Top5/Bottom5 representative confirmation, divergence and potential-reversal calls are unavailable.
Mapping
Broadcom growth and negative after-hours feedback coexist; A/H AI mapping is conditional
Broadcom AI semiconductor revenue was $16.7 billion, +221%, but its after-hours midpoint was about -0.85% versus the close; DELL's midpoint was about -1.29%. SMIC, Cambricon, Foxconn Industrial Internet and optical names must hold prior closes, beat STAR 50/ChiNext and expand volume to establish independent strength.

Pre-open Conclusion

Fact: US ETFs and oil rose, the PBOC reiterated an accommodative stance, and CSSC/Viva Goods disclosed quantified events.Broadcom still indicated about -0.85% after hours despite rapid growth, preserving the high-expectations constraint.

View: the base case favors oil, shipbuilding and strong filings; technology is a relative-strength trade only.Every direction requires a prior-close hold, benchmark outperformance and expanding volume together.

Uncertainty: all AKShare sources failed at 08:53, so no A/H breadth or leadership call is made; both Moomoo full rankings also failed.

Key Stock Setups

China CSSC Holdings
600150
Major order

Rationale: Ten 8,200-car LNG dual-fuel vehicle carriers are worth more than $1 billion, aligning a core order with the shipbuilding cycle.

Trigger: Hold the prior close and outperform both the Shanghai Composite and shipbuilding in the first hour on volume; wait for a pullback after an excessive gap.

Risk: Long delivery cycles, steel/FX swings and delayed profit recognition.

CNOOC
00883 / 600938
Oil mapping

Rationale: Brent/WTI settled +1.00%/+0.90% as the US-Iran conflict preserved a supply-risk premium.

Trigger: Oil holds its gain and both listings outperform Hang Seng/Shanghai benchmarks on expanding volume.

Risk: Rapid de-escalation, an oil reversal and policy intervention.

Midea Group
000333 / 00300
Buyback support

Rationale: Cumulative repurchases reached 99.798 million shares, 1.31% of shares, for about RMB8.02 billion, a material capital action.

Trigger: The A share holds the bottom of the buyback range and beats appliances; the H-share discount does not widen materially.

Risk: Repurchases may be partly priced, while demand and input costs can fluctuate.

Viva Goods
00933
Li Ning increase

Rationale: A HK$228.207 million purchase lifted the Li Ning stake to about 17.58%, a quantified two-stock Hong Kong event.

Trigger: Hold the prior close with rising volume while Li Ning (02331) also beats the Hang Seng consumer benchmark.

Risk: External financing adds leverage, concentration and correlated price risk.

KNT Holdings
01025
Watch only

Rationale: Cancelling the placing removes immediate dilution and the stock resumes at 09:00, but preliminary market feedback drove the withdrawal.

Trigger: Reassess only after continuous trading, a narrower spread and a reclaim of the prior close.

Risk: Reopening gap, extreme volatility, liquidity and future funding needs.

Sector Rotation Board

Relative strengthOil, services and shipbuilding; geopolitical premium and major orders align.
Policy catalystInnovation services, R&D testing and IP; wait for local budgets and orders.
Conditional technologySemiconductors, AI servers, optical and liquid cooling; validate local price-volume under high expectations.
Risk zoneFuel-intensive airlines, externally financed stake-building, resumptions and petitions.

Logic Chain

Accommodative PBOC + FX-stability message → liquidity and risk appetite gain a buffer → volume must confirm.

More than $1 billion ship orders and a HK$228.207 million stake increase → company events beat broad themes → watch relative strength.

Two-way geopolitical jump

More strikes lift oil; rapid de-escalation removes the energy premium.

Broadcom quotes weakened despite strong numbers; headline beats are not positive price feedback.

entries.title: 美股盘前：油价升至六周高位压制指数，SNOW与CIEN获强正反馈；AVGO、NTAP、HPE遭高预期惩罚
entries.summary: 道指、标普500和纳指100期指约+0.08%、-0.02%和-0.17%，10年期美债约4.776%，Brent约97.29美元。SNOW与CIEN财报后约涨24.29%和3%；AVGO、NTAP、HPE虽有强数字却下跌，只作风险观察。今晚关注ZS、IOT、DOCU、PATH与AMBA。
entries.html:
关键资产图

道指期指
+0.08% 抗跌
标普500期指
-0.02% 横盘

关键词云图

油价冲击霍尔木兹SNOW跃升AVGO负反馈CIEN光互联长债高位非农前夜软件扩散CybercabNVDA收购消费承压盘后软件财报
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
市场
期指接近平盘，纳指100相对偏弱
Reuters 7:04 ET记录道指、标普500和纳指100期指分别约+0.08%、-0.02%和-0.17%。事实是指数未失速；判断是油价和高利率令上行空间受限，周五非农前更可能维持震荡。
地缘
美伊紧张升级，Brent升至六周高位
Reuters称新一轮美国打击与以色列威胁推高供应中断担忧；Brent约97.29美元、涨1.7%，WTI约93.04美元、涨2.2%。霍尔木兹周三仅有6艘商品船通过，低于10日均值约13艘。
利率
美债收益率回落但仍高，9月加息概率约60%
10年期美债收益率约4.776%，较前值回落约1.8个基点；美元指数约跌0.47%，黄金期货约涨1.78%。缓冲来自美元和收益率回落，但油价使通胀尾部风险没有消失。
财报
Snowflake上调展望，盘前涨逾24%
Snowflake将FY2027产品收入预测从58.4亿美元上调至60.7亿美元，Q2产品收入同比增37%，AI产品贡献约一半增长加速；盘前约涨24.29%。基本面、卖方上调与价格反馈同向，但约15倍远期收入估值提高追涨风险。
财报
Broadcom双超仍跌约3.66%，高预期门槛主导
Broadcom Q3调整后EPS 3.32美元、收入295.9亿美元，均高于一致预期；AI芯片收入同比增221%至167亿美元，但盘前约跌3.66%。市场担忧利润率、数据中心租赁承诺及竞争，按价格反馈规则仅作风险观察、回避追多。
财报
Ciena受AI网络需求推动，盘前获得正反馈
Ciena调整后EPS 2.11美元，高于约1.73美元预期；收入16.7亿美元，高于约16.4亿美元预期，并将全年收入指引升至64.2亿美元。盘前约涨3%，与业绩方向一致。
财报
NTAP与HPE强劲数字后下跌，现金流与预期成焦点
NetApp收入20.3亿美元、EPS 2.58美元均显著超预期并上调全年指引，但盘前跌约8.5%，现金流下降和库存上升压过headline；HPE创纪录收入122亿美元并上调展望，盘前仍跌约4.36%。两者均等待止跌，不作多头推荐。
科技
Nvidia拟129.3亿美元收购Hugging Face
Reuters称该交易旨在扩大Nvidia在开放模型开发者生态中的入口，并缓冲大客户自研芯片风险。盘前NVDA约跌0.26%，价格未给出明确奖赏；因此视为战略事件而非即时多头信号。
汽车
Tesla Cybercab发布会提供事件催化，盘前约涨1.82%
Tesla将在奥斯汀展示无方向盘双座Cybercab；Reuters指出监管许可、有限车队和规模化仍是关键约束。盘前上涨提供轻度正反馈，但发布会细节和兑现路径决定缺口能否保持。
消费
Campbell弱展望并削减股息，盘前下跌约7%
Campbell预计FY2027净销售下降2%至4%、调整后EPS 1.65至1.80美元，均弱于市场预期，并将季度股息削减逾三分之一。消费者转向低价自有品牌，显示高油价之外仍有需求压力。

盘前结论

事实：期指接近平盘，10年期美债约4.776%，Brent约97.29美元。SNOW与CIEN财报后分别约涨24.29%和3%，而AVGO、NTAP、HPE在强数字后仍下跌。判断：基准情景是小幅震荡开盘，软件受SNOW带动、能源受油价支撑，但高久期科技难以全面扩张。优先选择价格已确认的个股，不把headline beat自动等同于买入信号。

不确定性：霍尔木兹消息、10:00 ET服务业PMI/ISM、周五非农及今晚软件财报都可能改变节奏。若QQQ转强且10年期收益率保持在4.80%下方，风险偏好可改善；反之应收缩仓位。

重点个股推荐

Snowflake
SNOW
财报强势

推荐理由：上调FY2027产品收入预测，AI驱动消费加速；盘前约涨24.29%，成交与相对强度均获明确市场确认。

触发因素：开盘守住盘前缺口的一半，且前30分钟继续强于IGV/软件同业；不追逐失控的第一笔成交。

风险点：约15倍远期收入和121倍以上远期盈利估值极高；若跌破盘前区间中点，转为获利回吐风险。

Ciena
CIEN
AI网络

推荐理由：EPS、收入与全年指引均超预期，AI数据中心互联需求支撑，盘前约涨3%且方向与基本面一致。

触发因素：守住盘前低点并在开盘后继续强于网络设备同业；量能数据不完整，不写作放量。

风险点：自6月高点仍有较大回撤，估值与订单兑现波动高；若开盘转负则取消多头观察。

Tesla
TSLA
事件驱动

推荐理由：Cybercab发布会构成明确催化，盘前约涨1.82%，相对纳指100获得轻度正反馈。

触发因素：发布细节改善商业化时间表，且开盘守住360美元附近并保持强于QQQ。

风险点：监管许可、无方向盘车型合规、车队规模和估值都要求更强证据；事件兑现后可能卖事实。

ServiceNow
NOW
软件映射

推荐理由：SNOW强劲消费趋势外溢至企业软件，NOW盘前约涨2.82%，明显强于纳指100。

触发因素：开盘后软件板块广度维持，NOW守住盘前区间中点，并继续强于CRM与ADBE。

风险点：本身没有当日独立财报催化，涨幅主要来自同业映射；SNOW高开回落会迅速削弱逻辑。

板块轮动看板

强势观察云数据与企业软件，SNOW领涨并带动NOW、CRM、ADBE；CIEN代表AI网络互联。
事件驱动TSLA Cybercab发布会；NVDA收购Hugging Face仅作战略观察，等待价格确认。
压力方向AVGO、NTAP、HPE均在强数字后下跌；高预期、现金流、库存或利润率担忧压过beat。
验证信号QQQ能否收复平盘、10年期收益率能否守在4.80%下方、Brent是否继续冲高，以及SNOW缺口保持率。

逻辑链

中东冲突与霍尔木兹通行下降推高Brent至约97美元，能源供应风险重新计价。
更高油价抬升通胀尾部风险，使9月加息概率约60%，10年期收益率即使回落仍处高位。
高贴现率限制纳指扩张，资金转向有价格确认的财报赢家；AVGO、NTAP、HPE说明beat不足以支撑高预期。
因此开盘更可能呈指数横盘、个股分化；SNOW、CIEN、TSLA与NOW需以缺口保持和相对强度继续验收。

盘后财报 beat 概率

以下概率基于已知一致预期、历史 surprise、近期指引、行业景气与可得卖方信息，是判断而非确定事实；公司IR或可靠日历确认以下公司在9月3日盘后披露。

高概率 64% · ZS一致预期约EPS 1.09美元、收入8.77亿美元，基本贴近公司Q4收入8.75亿至8.78亿美元及EPS 1.08至1.09美元指引。Q3收入8.50亿美元、同比增25%，高于8.34亿至8.36亿美元指引，ARR增25%，历史执行提供支撑；风险是公司曾提示FY2027增长谨慎，卖方对远期增速门槛仍高。
高概率 62% · IOT一致预期约EPS 0.16美元、收入4.83亿美元。Q1收入4.788亿美元、同比增31%，期末ARR 19.91亿美元、增30%，EPS 0.17美元高于约0.10美元预期，并将全年收入指引上调至约20.05亿至20.13亿美元。大客户与Operational AI景气支持，但高增长估值令指引稍弱也可能受罚。
中概率 57% · DOCU一致预期约EPS 1.08美元、收入8.67亿美元，处于公司8.65亿至8.69亿美元指引中点。Q1收入8.302亿美元、同比增9%，EPS 1.09美元高于约0.99美元预期，IAM占ARR比重升至12.6%；但增长仍为高个位数，billings与转型执行决定是否构成真正超预期。
中概率 54% · PATH一致预期约EPS 0.15美元、收入3.98亿美元；公司Q2收入指引3.95亿至4.00亿美元。Q1收入4.184亿美元，比约3.972亿美元预期高5.3%，但EPS 0.15美元略低于0.16美元预期；Agentic Automation需求与首个季度GAAP经营利润是支撑，ARR增速与大型平台竞争是风险。
低概率 48% · AMBA一致预期约EPS 0.17美元、收入1.08亿美元，收入接近公司上季给出的约1.08亿美元指引。Q1收入1.004亿美元、同比增16.9%，EPS 0.11美元小幅高于0.10美元预期；汽车与边缘AI需求积极，但非GAAP毛利率由62.0%降至59.9%，卖方修正与盘前量价信息不足，故仅给低概率。

风险雷达

霍尔木兹供应冲击

更多航运受阻或报复行动会推高油价、通胀预期与利率。

10年期收益率重上4.80%

高久期软件、半导体和小盘成长可能迅速转弱。

强业绩仍被卖出

AVGO、NTAP、HPE均属负反馈，未止跌前只观察、回避追多。

事件兑现风险

TSLA Cybercab与NVDA收购都需要监管、整合和商业化细节，不能只按标题交易。

盘后财报集中

ZS、IOT、DOCU、PATH、AMBA的指引可能重定价软件和边缘AI，隔夜仓位须单独管理。

数据来源与时间点

来源与时点：Reuters（期指、中东冲突、油价、美债、SNOW、NVDA、Campbell、TSLA）、公司IR与SEC文件（AVGO、HPE、ZS、IOT、DOCU、PATH、AMBA）、Investing.com与Nasdaq财报日历和盘前报价、Barron’s（CIEN、NTAP交叉核验）。行情主要抓取于2026-09-03 20:15—20:30 CST（08:15—08:30 ET），报价可能延迟；个别盘前成交量、卖方修正和财报样本信息不足已明确降级。所有概率均为判断，不是确定事实。
entries.html_en:
Key Asset Map

Dow futures
+0.08% resilient

-0.02% flat

-0.17% softer

+1.70% inflation

4.776% elevated

Keyword Cloud

Oil shockHormuzSNOW surgeAVGO penaltyCIEN opticsHigh yieldsJobs eveSoftware read-throughCybercabNVDA dealConsumer strainSoftware earnings
BullishBearishNeutralw1-w5 indicate heat/importance, not percentage moves.
Major News Summary
Market
Futures hover near flat; Nasdaq 100 lags
Reuters recorded Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures at roughly +0.08%, -0.02% and -0.17% at 7:04 ET. The tape is not breaking down, but oil and elevated rates cap upside; range trading is more likely before Friday payrolls.
Geopolitics
US-Iran tensions lift Brent to a six-week high
Reuters said renewed U.S. strikes and Israeli threats raised supply-disruption fears; Brent was about $97.29, up 1.7%, and WTI about $93.04, up 2.2%. Only six commodity vessels crossed Hormuz Wednesday versus a 10-day average near 13.
Rates
Treasury yields ease but remain high; hike odds near 60%
The 10-year Treasury yield was near 4.776%, down about 1.8 basis points; the dollar index fell roughly 0.47% and gold futures gained about 1.78%. Softer yields and the dollar help, but oil keeps inflation tail risk alive.
Earnings
Snowflake raises outlook and jumps more than 24%
Snowflake lifted FY2027 product-revenue guidance to $6.07 billion from $5.84 billion, with Q2 product revenue up 37% and AI products driving about half the acceleration; shares rose about 24.29% premarket. Fundamentals, analyst revisions and price agree, though a roughly 15x forward-sales valuation raises chase risk.
Earnings
Broadcom beats but falls about 3.66% as the bar stays high
Broadcom posted Q3 adjusted EPS of $3.32 and revenue of $29.59 billion, both above consensus, while AI-chip revenue rose 221% to $16.7 billion; shares still fell about 3.66% premarket. Margin, lease-commitment and competition concerns make this a watch-only setup, not a long pick.
Earnings
Ciena gets a positive reaction to AI networking demand
Ciena delivered adjusted EPS of $2.11 versus about $1.73 expected and revenue of $1.67 billion versus about $1.64 billion, then raised full-year revenue guidance to $6.42 billion. Shares gained about 3% premarket, confirming the result.
Earnings
NTAP and HPE fall despite strong numbers
NetApp's $2.03 billion revenue and $2.58 EPS beat sharply and guidance rose, yet shares fell about 8.5% as weaker cash flow and higher inventory outweighed the headline; HPE posted record $12.2 billion revenue and raised guidance but fell about 4.36%. Both remain watch-only pending stabilization.
Tech
Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.93 billion
Reuters said the deal expands Nvidia's reach into the open-model developer ecosystem and may offset customers building their own chips. NVDA was about 0.26% lower premarket, so the market has not supplied a clear positive signal yet.
Autos
Tesla's Cybercab event offers a catalyst; shares gain about 1.82%
Tesla will showcase its two-seat, steering-wheel-free Cybercab in Austin; Reuters highlights permits, a limited fleet and scaling as key constraints. The premarket gain is mildly positive, but event details and execution will determine whether the move holds.
Consumer
Campbell cuts its outlook and dividend; shares fall about 7%
Campbell forecast FY2027 net sales down 2% to 4% and adjusted EPS of $1.65 to $1.80, both below expectations, while cutting its quarterly dividend by more than one-third. Trade-down to private labels shows demand strain beyond the oil shock.

Premarket Conclusion

Facts: futures are near flat, the 10-year Treasury yield is about 4.776%, and Brent is about $97.29. SNOW and CIEN gained roughly 24.29% and 3% after results, while AVGO, NTAP and HPE fell despite strong numbers.View: the base case is a choppy, near-flat open. Software gets a SNOW read-through and energy benefits from oil, but long-duration tech is unlikely to broaden decisively. Favor price-confirmed names; do not treat a headline beat as an automatic buy signal.

Uncertainty: Hormuz headlines, 10:00 ET services PMI/ISM, Friday payrolls and tonight's software earnings can change the tape. Risk appetite can improve if QQQ turns higher while the 10-year stays below 4.80%; otherwise exposure should be reduced.

Focus Stock Picks

Snowflake
SNOW
Earnings strength

Why: FY2027 product-revenue guidance rose as AI accelerated consumption; the roughly 24.29% premarket jump provides clear price and relative-strength confirmation.

Trigger: Hold at least half the premarket gap and remain stronger than IGV/software peers through the first 30 minutes; avoid chasing a disorderly opening print.

Risk: A roughly 15x forward-sales and 121x-plus forward-earnings valuation is demanding; a break below the premarket midpoint would flag profit-taking risk.

Ciena
CIEN
AI networking

Why: EPS, revenue and full-year guidance beat as AI data-center interconnect demand stayed firm; the roughly 3% premarket gain confirms the direction.

Trigger: Hold the premarket low and continue to outperform networking peers after the open; volume data is incomplete and is not described as heavy.

Risk: The stock remains well below its June high and order conversion is volatile; cancel the long watch if it turns negative after the open.

Tesla
TSLA
Event-driven

Why: The Cybercab event is a clear catalyst, and the roughly 1.82% premarket gain is a modest positive signal versus Nasdaq 100.

Trigger: Event details improve the commercialization timeline, while shares hold near $360 and remain stronger than QQQ after the open.

Risk: Permits, compliance for a steering-wheel-free vehicle, fleet scale and valuation all require stronger proof; the event could trigger sell-the-news action.

ServiceNow
NOW
Software read-through

Why: SNOW's stronger consumption trend lifted enterprise software, with NOW up about 2.82% premarket and clearly outperforming Nasdaq 100.

Trigger: Software breadth holds after the open, NOW keeps the premarket midpoint, and it continues to outperform CRM and ADBE.

Risk: There is no same-day company-specific earnings catalyst; the move is largely a peer read-through and would weaken quickly if SNOW fades.

Sector Rotation Board

Strength Watchcloud data and enterprise software, led by SNOW with NOW, CRM and ADBE read-through; CIEN represents AI networking.
Event-drivenTSLA's Cybercab event; NVDA's Hugging Face acquisition remains a strategic watch pending price confirmation.
PressureAVGO, NTAP and HPE all fell despite strong numbers as high expectations, cash flow, inventory or margin concerns outweighed beats.
Validationwhether QQQ reclaims flat, the 10-year stays below 4.80%, Brent extends higher, and SNOW preserves its gap.

Logic Chain

Middle East escalation and fewer Hormuz transits lift Brent toward $97, repricing supply risk.
Higher oil raises inflation tail risk, leaving September hike odds near 60% and the 10-year yield elevated even after easing.
A high discount rate limits Nasdaq breadth and sends capital toward price-confirmed earnings winners; AVGO, NTAP and HPE show that beats alone are insufficient.
The open is therefore more likely to feature flat indexes and sharp stock dispersion; SNOW, CIEN, TSLA and NOW still require gap retention and relative-strength confirmation.

After-close Earnings Beat Probability

These probabilities use known consensus, historical surprises, recent guidance, industry conditions and available analyst information. They are judgments, not facts; company IR or reliable calendars confirm the following companies report after the September 3 close.

High 64% · ZSConsensus is about $1.09 EPS and $877 million revenue, near company Q4 guidance of $875-$878 million and $1.08-$1.09 EPS. Q3 revenue of $850 million, up 25%, exceeded $834-$836 million guidance and ARR grew 25%, supporting execution; risk is cautious FY2027 growth framing and a high forward bar.
High 62% · IOTConsensus is about $0.16 EPS and $483 million revenue. Q1 revenue was $478.8 million, up 31%, ending ARR reached $1.991 billion, up 30%, EPS of $0.17 beat roughly $0.10, and full-year revenue guidance rose to about $2.005-$2.013 billion. Large-customer and Operational AI momentum help, but valuation makes guidance sensitivity high.
Medium 57% · DOCUConsensus is about $1.08 EPS and $867 million revenue, at the midpoint of company guidance of $865-$869 million. Q1 revenue rose 9% to $830.2 million and $1.09 EPS beat roughly $0.99, while IAM reached 12.6% of ARR; however growth remains high-single-digit and billings plus transition execution determine the quality of any beat.
Medium 54% · PATHConsensus is about $0.15 EPS and $398 million revenue, versus company Q2 guidance of $395-$400 million. Q1 revenue of $418.4 million beat roughly $397.2 million by 5.3%, but $0.15 EPS missed $0.16; Agentic Automation demand and the first quarterly GAAP operating profit help, while ARR growth and platform competition remain risks.
Low 48% · AMBAConsensus is about $0.17 EPS and $108 million revenue, close to the company's prior guidance near $108 million. Q1 revenue rose 16.9% to $100.4 million and $0.11 EPS narrowly beat $0.10; automotive and edge-AI demand are constructive, but non-GAAP gross margin fell to 59.9% from 62.0%, while analyst-revision and premarket-flow data are limited.

Risk Radar
